name: Kojin Taxi
source:
Main character is a taxi driver. His only purpose is to play with bodies of pretty girls, looking at their face expression. He reveals girls secrets and blackmails them into having a ride with him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名出租车司机，唯一目的便是玩弄漂亮女孩的身体，欣赏她们脸上的表情。他会揭开女孩们的秘密，再以此威胁她们搭乘自己的车。
